summary: Rabbi Soffer concludes Masekhet Bechorot by discussing the halakhic status of animals when a mistake occurs during the counting of the tenth animal for Maaser Behemah. He explores the opinions of the Hakhamim and Rabbi Yehuda regarding whether such animals are offered as Korbanot or left to die, and examines the validity of an agent's actions when they make a mistake on behalf of an owner. The class concludes with a siyum on Masekhet Bechorot and begins the first Mishna of Masekhet Arakhin.
questions: What happens if two animals are designated as the tenth animal simultaneously?
Does an agent's mistake in counting Maaser Behemah invalidate the designation?
Can an animal designated by mistake as the tenth be offered as a Korban?
Who is eligible to make or be the subject of an Erech vow?
